title: Returned!  Not for me.
text: Returned!  Not for me.. This was twice the size - yet held half as much - as of my old shower rack. I cleaned the old one up. It’s missing a suction cup, but at least I can still store all my bottles of shampoo, conditioner, etc.

product_metadata.title: Kenney 11" x 24" x 4.5" 2-Tier Hanging Shower Caddy, White
features: The Kenney 2-Tier Hanging Shower Caddy helps keep your bath and shower products organized with two shelves, two hooks, and a soap dish
Rubber collar helps keep the caddy in place when hanging from the shower head
Included rubber suction cups provide additional stability and reduce the need to balance the weight of items in your caddy
Dimensions: 24" H x 11" W x 4.5" D
description: Organize your bath and maximize your storage with the Kenney 2-Tier Hanging Shower Caddy. The white finish and soft curves bring a more modern, yet functional, style to this classic bathroom storage solution. This steel shower caddy is rust-resistant and allows you to store all of your shower essentials in one place. This caddy features two shelves, two hooks, and a soap dish. The deep baskets allow for varying size bottles. The wire soap bar shelf allows excess water to drain and air to circulate, drying the bar of soap. The two hooks are great for hanging loofahs, washcloths, or other items like a waterproof speaker. The caddy comes with a rubber collar and suction cups to help keep it in place. The collar also prevents scratches to your showerhead, and the suction cups reduce the need to balance items. This caddy measures 24" H x 11" W x 4.5" D and can be hung from showerheads with necks up to 0.75" in diameter.
